title: 对比 Flow Matching 权重 λ

standard.summary: ∆FM 对比项的权重系数 λ，控制「推离其它样本流方向」的力度。论文推荐 0.05，也是默认值。
standard.effect: loss = 主损失 - λ·MSE(pred, 负样本目标)。λ 越大条件间排斥越强；仅在 contrastive_flow_matching 开启时参与计算。
standard.whenToUse: 开启 ∆FM 后按 0.05 起步；多概念区分度仍不够时可小步上调到 0.1 左右观察。
standard.avoidWhen: contrastive_flow_matching 关闭时无意义；λ ≥ 0.2 后对比项容易主导训练，主目标拟合变差。

standard_en.summary: The weight lambda on the dFM contrastive term, which sets how hard the model is pushed away from other samples' flow directions. The paper recommends 0.05, which is also the default.
standard_en.effect: loss = main loss - lambda x MSE(pred, negative-sample target). A larger lambda repels conditions more strongly; it only enters the computation when contrastive_flow_matching is on.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start at 0.05 once dFM is on; if multiple concepts still are not separated enough, raise it in small steps towards 0.1 and watch.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when contrastive_flow_matching is off. Past lambda >= 0.2 the contrastive term tends to dominate and the main objective fits worse.

advanced.principle: λ 平衡「拟合自身目标」与「远离他人目标」两个目标。由于对比项是负值，λ 直接决定 loss 数值的系统性下移量，损失曲线的绝对值失去与基线的可比性，应看收敛趋势而非绝对值。
advanced.intervention: trainer_execution_loop_builder.py 从 config 读取后传入训练循环；training_step_loss_execution_core.py 以 lam=float(cfm_lambda) 调用 apply_contrastive_flow_matching。
advanced.expectedImpact: 适度 λ 下多条件生成的辨识度提升；过大时出现「过度分离」伪影（颜色/风格极化）。
advanced.tradeoffs: λ 与 batch size 相关：batch 越大负样本越多样，同一 λ 的有效排斥力越稳定；小 batch 建议保守取值。
advanced.codePath: configs_dataset.py:cfm_lambda 默认 0.05；training_step_loss_execution_core.py 传入 apply_contrastive_flow_matching

advanced_en.principle: λ balances "fit your own target" against "stay away from others' targets". Since the contrastive term is negative, λ directly determines a systematic downward shift of the loss value — the curve's absolute value loses comparability with baselines, so judge by convergence trend rather than absolute values.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_execution_loop_builder.py reads it from config and passes it to the training loop; training_step_loss_execution_core.py calls apply_contrastive_flow_matching with lam=float(cfm_lambda).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Moderate λ improves separation of multi-condition generation; too large produces "over-separation" artifacts (color/style polarization).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: λ interacts with batch size: bigger batches give more diverse negatives and steadier effective repulsion at the same λ; be conservative with small batches.
advanced_en.codePath: configs_dataset.py:cfm_lambda default 0.05; training_step_loss_execution_core.py passes it into apply_contrastive_flow_matching
